keyPoints.bm: Perang Dunia Pertama: 1914–1918. Perang Dunia Kedua: 1939–1945.

keyPoints.en: Japan wanted raw materials (rubber, tin, oil), markets and an Asian bloc — the Co-Prosperity Sphere.
keyPoints.bm: Jepun mahukan bahan mentah (getah, bijih timah, minyak), pasaran dan blok Asia — Kawasan Kesemakmuran Bersama.

keyPoints.en: Slogan "Asia for Asians" was propaganda to win support.
keyPoints.bm: Slogan "Asia untuk Asia" ialah propaganda untuk meraih sokongan.

keyPoints.en: 8 Dec 1941: landing at Kota Bharu. 15 Feb 1942: Singapore falls (Syonan-to).
keyPoints.bm: 8 Dis 1941: pendaratan di Kota Bharu. 15 Feb 1942: Singapura jatuh (Syonan-to).

keyPoints.en: Different treatment of ethnic groups: harsh on Chinese (Sook Ching), Malays given some posts, Indians recruited for the INA.
keyPoints.bm: Layanan berbeza mengikut kaum: kejam terhadap orang Cina (Sook Ching), orang Melayu diberi sesetengah jawatan, orang India direkrut ke dalam INA.

keyPoints.en: Economy: food shortages, "banana money" inflation, forced labour (e.g. Death Railway).
keyPoints.bm: Ekonomi: kekurangan makanan, inflasi "duit pisang", kerahan tenaga (cth. Landasan Kereta Api Maut).

tip.en: Group effects into politics, economy and society for full marks.
tip.bm: Kumpulkan kesan mengikut politik, ekonomi dan sosial untuk markah penuh.

keyPoints.en: Resistance: MPAJA, Force 136, Askar Melayu Setia, Double Tenth Revolt (Albert Kwok, 1943).
keyPoints.bm: Penentangan: MPAJA, Force 136, Askar Melayu Setia, Pemberontakan Double Tenth (Albert Kwok, 1943).

keyPoints.en: Atomic bombs on Hiroshima and Nagasaki; Japan surrendered on 15 August 1945.
keyPoints.bm: Bom atom di Hiroshima dan Nagasaki; Jepun menyerah pada 15 Ogos 1945.

keyPoints.en: Before the British returned, the MPAJA briefly took control and caused ethnic tension.
keyPoints.bm: Sebelum British kembali, MPAJA menguasai keadaan seketika dan menimbulkan ketegangan kaum.

keyPoints.en: Overall effect: Western superiority myth broken; nationalism grew stronger.
keyPoints.bm: Kesan keseluruhan: mitos keunggulan Barat runtuh; nasionalisme semakin kuat.
